title: Install this app for your interview
scenario: A recruiter schedules a video interview but says the company uses a private conferencing tool. The installer asks for screen recording, accessibility control and a system password.

answers.A: Ask for a browser-based or mainstream alternative until the tool can be verified.
answers.B: Install it because companies often use specialized interview software, then uninstall afterward.
answers.C: Verify the recruiter and software through the company’s official careers/IT information before installing anything.

explanation: Deep device permissions can expose passwords and files. A legitimate employer can explain and verify its interview tooling.
proTip: The interview should evaluate you, not gain admin access to your laptop.
